parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.sport, t.captain_user_id, me.id AS me_id, mm.id AS my_member_id, mm.role AS my_role, tg.id AS target_id, tg.user_id AS target_user, tg.role AS target_role, tg.status AS target_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = t.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.role <> 'COACH') AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = t.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.user_id IS NOT NULL AND x.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN')) AS admins, (SELECT x.id FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = t.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.role = 'CAPTAIN' LIMIT 1) AS cap_member_id, (SELECT x.user_id FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = t.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.role = 'CAPTAIN' LIMIT 1) AS cap_user FROM app_users me JOIN teams t ON t.code = $2 LEFT JOIN team_members mm ON mm.team_id = t.id AND mm.user_id = me.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN team_members tg ON tg.team_id = t.id AND tg.id = $3 WHERE me.phone = $1
